name: The Penguins of Madagascar
description: The adventures of four penguins—Skipper, Kowalski, Private, and Rico, who perform various commando-like missions to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused, or made worse, by their zoo neighbors, King Julien XIII (a ring-tailed lemur), Maurice (an aye-aye), and Mort (a mouse lemur).

videos.title: A Christmas Caper
videos.overview: The penguins of the Central Park Zoo have an adventure in the city on Christmas Eve.

videos.title: Merry Madagascar
videos.overview: When Santa and his reindeer crash onto the island of Madagascar it's up to Alex, Marty, Gloria, Melman and those wacky penguins to deliver the presents and save Christmas.

videos.title: Dr. Blowhole's Revenge
videos.overview: Bent on an agenda to take over the world, the penguins' mad dolphin nemesis, Dr. Blowhole, kidnaps King Julien in an effort to lure the flightless force into a trap so that he can annihilate them once and for all. It’s up to the penguins to spring the trap before Blowhole’s plan to flood the Earth comes to fruition.

videos.title: The All Nighter Before Christmas
videos.overview: When the zoo is closed for Christmas, the animals prepare for "Kidsmas" -- their annual celebration complete with decorations, food, gifts and a visit from Santa.

videos.title: Gone in a Flash
videos.overview: Julien and Maurice fight over a camera that fell from the sky.

videos.title: Launchtime
videos.overview: Frustrated by their obnoxious lemur neighbors, the penguins decide to take a vacation... to the moon.

videos.title: Haunted Habitat
videos.overview: The penguins leap into action when a spooky noise frightens Marlene.

videos.title: Operation: Plush and Cover
videos.overview: The popularity of stuffed Mort dolls causes Julien to sabotage the toys, prompting a recall.

videos.title: Happy King Julien Day
videos.overview: Maurice bribes the animals with candy so they'll celebrate "King Julien Day."

videos.title: Paternal Egg-Stinct

videos.overview: When the zoo installs web cams to bring in new visitors, Private accidentally becomes an Internet star.

videos.overview: Skipper accidentally causes King Julien to lose his beloved crown. Now the penguins go on a dangerous mission to retrieve the crown from the sewer.

videos.title: The Hidden

awards: Won 1 Primetime Emmy. 20 wins & 33 nominations total
